tools.name: list_apartments
tools.description: The five holiday apartments of Apartments Perlamar at Passeig de Neptú 24, Valencia, on the beachfront of Las Arenas / Malvarrosa: capacity, beds, sea view, terrace and link.

tools.name: get_apartment_details
tools.description: Full description of one apartment: texts, beds, amenities, check-in/out times, minimum nights, photos and public address.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Night-by-night availability of one apartment for up to 120 days, from a snapshot refreshed every hour. Use search_availability or get_quote to confirm live availability and price.

tools.name: search_availability
tools.description: Live search: which apartments are free for the given dates and guests, with the total price for the stay (direct-booking rate) and a booking link. Prices in EUR.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Exact live quote for one apartment: price breakdown (nights, cleaning, pet fee, taxes), total and cancellation policy of each rate, plus a booking link with everything pre-filled. Does not book or hold the dates.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Check-in/out times, cancellation, payment methods, pets, house rules, guest registration, extras, contact and FAQ.
